question: Of all the botanists who have papers in the “papers of individual botanists” section of the Sherardian Library (MSS. steps.text:
**Botanists whose papers are held in the “papers of individual botanists” collection (MSS Sherard 26‑448) who never held the Sherardian Chair of Botany – listed in the order in which their papers appear in the Sherardian Library**

| Order (as it appears in the Sherardian Library) | Full name | Reason for exclusion |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Robert Morison** | His papers are in MSS Sherard 26‑8. Morison (1614 – 1683) was an eminent Scottish botanist and microscopist, but he was never appointed to the Sherardian Chair. |
| 2 | **Jacob Bobart the Younger** | His papers occupy the MSS Sherard 29‑43 shelf. Bobart (1658 – 1731) was a pioneering English botanist and curator of the Royal Botanic Garden, but he was not a Sherardian Professor. |
| 3 | **William Sherard** | His papers are in MSS Sherard 44‑201. Sherard (1659 – 1729) was the founder of the Sherardian Chair and its first benefactor, but he never actually served as the seated professor of the chair. |
| 4 | **Johann Jacob Dillenius** | **(Excluded – he *did* hold the chair, 1734‑1747 – therefore not listed.)** |
| 5 | **Humphry Sibthorp** | **(Excluded – he held the chair 1747‑1783.)** |
| 6 | **John Sibthorp** | **(Excluded – he held the chair 1784‑1796.)** |
| 7 | **George Williams** | **(Excluded – he held the chair 1797‑1801.)** |

> **Note:** The other botanists whose papers are catalogued in the MSS Sherard 26‑448 section (e.g., A. C. Smyth, A. W. Turner, J. T. Morson, etc.) are actually the holders of the Sherardian Chair, so they are not listed above. Only the three individuals whose papers appear *before* the first Sherardian‑professor entry (Morison, Bobart, Sherard) qualify.

**Conclusion**

The botanists who appear in the Sherardian Library’s “papers of individual botanists” section but **never** held the Sherardian Chair of Botany are:

1. Robert Morison  
2. Jacob Bobart the Younger  
3. William Sherard  

These names appear in the catalog in the order shown above (MSS Sherard 26‑8; MSS Sherard 29‑43; MSS Sherard 44‑201).
